_about: Probe set for SORA's memory embedder (docs/plans/MEMORY_MANAGER_2026-10-08.md step 1). memories: corpus; questions: a differently worded question per memory (id = the memory it should find); pairs: labelled relations for the network bands; images: captions written by looking at each image; spoken: memories read aloud by Windows' voice. owner:true marks the owner's own memories (from .local/manual-test, 2026-10-09).

memories.text: My workshop key is under the blue pot by the back door.
By the way, I prefer tea over coffee.
From now on always answer me briefly.
My sister is called Ada and she hates surprises.
My favourite colour is teal.
My brother Adam is moving to Leeds in December.
I only drink coffee in the mornings before work.
Our cat is called Miso and she is twelve years old.
I'm trying to reach rank 500 on ScoreSaber in Beat Saber this year.
My graphics card is an AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT with 16 GB of memory.
My A Level exams start on the 14th of May.
I'm allergic to peanuts, so please never suggest recipes with them.
I parked the car on level 3 of the station car park.
Mum's birthday is on the 2nd of March.
When I'm coding I like lo-fi playlists on Spotify.
I try to be in bed by 11pm on school nights.
The desk lamp flickers if the dimmer is below half.
The Wi-Fi password for the guest network is on the fridge.
We're planning a weekend trip to the Lake District in spring.
I'm learning Japanese and I practise kanji every evening.
SORA should speak in a calm voice and never shout.
My bike tyre has a slow puncture on the back wheel.
I have a dentist appointment next Thursday at 4pm.
Loud notification sounds give me headaches.
My old laptop is in the bottom drawer of the desk.
Jamie owes me twenty pounds from the cinema.
The basil on the windowsill needs water every two days.
I finished Zenless Zone Zero's main story last week.
My bus to college leaves at 7:45 from the stop outside Tesco.
I like dark themes and big fonts in every app.
